title: Hello, World!
referenceMarkdown:
In Lua, printing text to the screen is done with the `print()` function.

`print("Hello, World!")`

Lua scripts run top to bottom, one statement at a time — no `main` function needed.
challengeMarkdown: Print the message `Hello, World!` to the screen using `print()`.
